module_summary: Multi-cycle RV32 CPU: cpu_state FSM sequences fetch/decode/regfile-read/ALU/memory over a 32-entry register file, with a mem_state-driven native memory bus, plus optional PCPI coprocessor, IRQ and trace logic.

anchors.name: cpu_state
anchors.why: Main CPU FSM: fetch, ld_rs1, ld_rs2, exec, shift, stmem, ldmem, trap states.

anchors.name: cpuregs
anchors.why: 32x32 register file written at latched_rd, read by decoded_rs1/rs2.

anchors.name: reg_pc
anchors.why: Program counter of current instruction, loaded from current_pc at fetch.

anchors.name: mem_valid
anchors.why: Memory bus request valid, raised by mem_state machine for fetch/load/store.

anchors.name: mem_ready
anchors.why: Memory acknowledge; with mem_valid forms mem_xfer completing transfers.

anchors.name: mem_addr
anchors.why: Memory bus address, registered from look-ahead mem_la_addr.

anchors.name: mem_rdata
anchors.why: Memory read data feeding instruction decoder and load path.

anchors.name: mem_wdata
anchors.why: Store data to memory, registered from byte/half-replicated mem_la_wdata.

anchors.name: reg_op1
anchors.why: ALU operand 1 and load/store address base, loaded from rs1 or pc.

anchors.name: reg_op2
anchors.why: ALU operand 2 / store data, loaded from rs2 or decoded immediate.

anchors.name: reg_out
anchors.why: Result register holding ALU/load/CSR result for regfile writeback.

anchors.name: alu_out
anchors.why: ALU result mux: add/sub, compare, xor/or/and, shifts of reg_op1/reg_op2.

anchors.name: mem_state
anchors.why: Memory interface FSM controlling mem_valid request and transfer completion.

anchors.name: mem_do_rinst
anchors.why: Instruction fetch request flag; gates memory FSM and decoder triggering.

anchors.name: mem_done
anchors.why: Memory transaction complete; advances cpu_state and triggers decoder.

anchors.name: decoder_trigger
anchors.why: Enables second-stage instruction decode after fetch completes.

anchors.name: is_lb_lh_lw_lbu_lhu
anchors.why: Decoded load-class flag steering cpu_state to ldmem and decode of loads.

anchors.name: decoded_rs1
anchors.why: Decoded rs1 register index addressing the register file read.

anchors.name: trap
anchors.why: Trap output asserted when CPU enters trap state (illegal insn/misalign).

anchors.name: count_cycle
anchors.why: 64-bit cycle counter read by rdcycle/rdcycleh instructions.

anchors.name: count_instr
anchors.why: 64-bit retired-instruction counter incremented on instruction launch.

anchors.name: reg_next_pc
anchors.why: Next sequential PC (pc+2/4) used to form current_pc.

anchors.name: current_pc
anchors.why: Selects next PC: reg_next_pc, branch target from reg_out/alu_out_q, or IRQ vector.

anchors.name: alu_out_0
anchors.why: Compare result (eq/lt/ltu) for branches and slt instructions.

anchors.name: reg_sh
anchors.why: Remaining shift amount counted down in multi-cycle shift state.

anchors.name: alu_wait
anchors.why: Stalls exec state one cycle for two-cycle ALU/compare.

anchors.name: latched_store
anchors.why: Marks result pending writeback to regfile and PC update at fetch.

anchors.name: latched_branch
anchors.why: Marks taken branch/jump so fetch redirects PC.

anchors.name: latched_rd
anchors.why: Destination register index for regfile writeback.

anchors.name: cpuregs_write
anchors.why: Register file write enable at fetch when result is latched.

anchors.name: cpuregs_wrdata
anchors.why: Regfile write data mux: pc+4, reg_out/alu_out_q, or IRQ return address.

anchors.name: cpuregs_rs1
anchors.why: Register file read port 1 value loaded into reg_op1.

anchors.name: launch_next_insn
anchors.why: Fetch-state condition that launches the next decoded instruction.

anchors.name: decoder_pseudo_trigger
anchors.why: Re-runs decoder on held instruction without new fetch.

anchors.name: is_beq_bne_blt_bge_bltu_bgeu
anchors.why: Decoded branch-class flag selecting compare path and branch handling.

anchors.name: instr_lui
anchors.why: Representative per-instruction decode flag (instr_* family).

anchors.name: instr_trap
anchors.why: Illegal instruction detect: none of instr_* set; drives trap/PCPI path.

anchors.name: decoded_rd
anchors.why: Decoded destination register index copied into latched_rd.

anchors.name: decoded_rs2
anchors.why: Decoded rs2 register index addressing regfile read port 2.

anchors.name: decoded_imm
anchors.why: Decoded sign-extended immediate loaded into reg_op2.

anchors.name: mem_wstrb
anchors.why: Byte write strobes for stores, zero for reads.

anchors.name: mem_instr
anchors.why: Indicates current memory access is an instruction fetch.

anchors.name: mem_la_read
anchors.why: Look-ahead read request one cycle before mem_valid.

anchors.name: mem_la_write
anchors.why: Look-ahead write request driven when mem_do_wdata in idle.

anchors.name: mem_la_addr
anchors.why: Look-ahead address: next_pc for fetch or reg_op1 for data access.

anchors.name: mem_do_rdata
anchors.why: Data load request flag to memory FSM.

anchors.name: mem_do_wdata
anchors.why: Data store request flag to memory FSM and mem_la_write.

anchors.name: mem_do_prefetch
anchors.why: Prefetch next instruction request during execution.

anchors.name: mem_xfer
anchors.why: Memory transfer beat: mem_valid && mem_ready.

anchors.name: mem_rdata_q
anchors.why: Latched instruction/read word used by decoder stage two.

anchors.name: mem_rdata_latched
anchors.why: Fetched instruction word feeding first-stage decode.

anchors.name: mem_wordsize
anchors.why: Selects word/half/byte formatting for load/store data and strobes.

anchors.name: mem_16bit_buffer
anchors.why: Buffers upper 16 bits for compressed-instruction fetch (COMPRESSED_ISA).

anchors.name: pcpi_valid
anchors.why: PCPI coprocessor request for unknown instructions (ENABLE_PCPI=0 default).

anchors.name: pcpi_ready
anchors.why: PCPI coprocessor done; merged into pcpi_int_ready.

anchors.name: pcpi_insn
anchors.why: Instruction word sent to PCPI coprocessor.

anchors.name: pcpi_rd
anchors.why: PCPI result data written back via reg_out.

anchors.name: pcpi_timeout_counter
anchors.why: Timeout countdown waiting for PCPI response before trapping.

anchors.name: irq_state
anchors.why: IRQ entry sequencer saving PC and pending mask into q-registers.

anchors.name: irq_pending
anchors.why: Pending interrupt vector gating IRQ entry (ENABLE_IRQ=0 default).

anchors.name: irq_mask
anchors.why: Software-written interrupt mask set by maskirq instruction.

anchors.name: timer
anchors.why: IRQ timer counting down, set by timer instruction.

anchors.name: irq_active
anchors.why: Set while servicing an interrupt, cleared by retirq.

anchors.name: eoi
anchors.why: End-of-interrupt output marking serviced IRQs.

anchors.name: trace_valid
anchors.why: Trace word valid pulse (ENABLE_TRACE=0 default).

anchors.name: trace_data
anchors.why: Trace payload: branch target, address or result with flags.

groups.name: Main controller
groups.description: cpu_state FSM sequencing fetch, register read, execute, shift, memory and trap phases.

groups.name: Instruction decoder
groups.description: Two-stage decode of fetched word into instr_* flags, register indices and immediate.

groups.name: Register file
groups.description: 32x32 cpuregs with write port at latched_rd and two read ports.

groups.name: ALU datapath
groups.description: Operand registers, combinational ALU/compare/shift and result register reg_out.

groups.name: Program counter
groups.description: reg_pc/reg_next_pc updated at fetch with sequential, branch or IRQ target.

groups.name: Memory interface
groups.description: mem_state FSM turning fetch/load/store requests into valid/ready bus transfers.

groups.name: Performance counters
groups.description: Cycle and retired-instruction counters for rdcycle/rdinstr.

groups.name: PCPI coprocessor port
groups.description: Offloads unknown instructions to coprocessor with timeout; disabled by default.

groups.name: Interrupt controller
groups.description: IRQ pending/mask/timer and entry sequencing; disabled by ENABLE_IRQ=0.

groups.name: Trace output
groups.description: Emits trace words for branches, addresses and results; disabled by default.
